metadata.title: Torus Surgery Constraints and Intermediate Covers of the Cartwright--Steger Surface
metadata.abstract: We study torus surgery on the Cartwright--Steger surface and the degree-two cover construction proposed in \cite[Remark~1]{ASY}. Every torus in this surface is integrally nullhomologous, and surgery on a fixed disjoint collection of such tori cannot decrease the first Betti number. We then determine the nodal-curve subgroup and complete the fundamental-group calculation in the degree-two construction. The resulting minimal symplectic manifold has signature zero and fundamental group $\Z/2$; for compatible symplectic gluings, its universal cover is an exotic symplectic $31\CP^2\#31\overline{\CP}^{\,2}$. The construction on the original Cartwright--Steger surface gives a minimal symplectic manifold with signature $-1$ and fundamental group $(\Z/2)^2$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: Cartwright–Steger torus surgery 与中间覆盖
analysis.workSummary: 证明其所有 torus 整同调为零且固定 disjoint surgery 不降低 b₁；完成 degree-two construction 的 π₁ 计算，得 π₁=Z₂ 的 minimal symplectic manifold 和 exotic 31CP²#31反CP² universal cover。
analysis.breakthrough: 澄清既有 construction 的群与覆盖拓扑，并限制降低 b₁ 的 surgery。
analysis.limitations: exotic universal-cover 断言使用 compatible symplectic gluing；原表面的另一构造具有不同签名及 π₁。
